PCMET302.subject: Mechanics of Solids
PCMET302.evidence: Compared two actual KTU S3 (R) November 2025 and S3 (S) May 2026 question papers (2024 Scheme). Both papers follow the same four-module structure. High priority topics recur across both papers or dominate the module's 9-mark problem; medium priority topics are supported by one paper or by shorter questions. This is a two-paper pattern, not a prediction.

topics.name: Composite bars and axial stresses in compound members
topics.evidence: 9-mark numerical in both papers: load sharing and stresses in steel/copper or steel/gun-metal composite members.

topics.name: Thermal stresses in compound bars
topics.evidence: 9-mark thermal-stress numerical in both papers, involving different materials and coefficients of expansion.

topics.name: Elasticity, Hooke's law, stress-strain and factor of safety
topics.evidence: Short-answer coverage across the two papers: Hooke's law, elastic moduli, factor of safety and linear/lateral strain.

topics.name: Torsion of circular shafts
topics.evidence: Both papers test torsion theory; May 2026 also asks a 9-mark solid-versus-hollow shaft comparison.

topics.name: Shear force and bending moment diagrams
topics.evidence: A 9-mark SFD/BMD problem appears in both papers.

topics.name: Bending equation and flexural strength
topics.evidence: Both papers include bending assumptions and a 5-mark beam-strength numerical.

topics.name: Slope and deflection of beams; Macaulay's method
topics.evidence: Both papers contain 9-mark deflection work; Macaulay's method is directly asked in May 2026 and used in a November 2025 problem.

topics.name: Euler and Rankine column theory
topics.evidence: Both papers include 9-mark column-buckling calculations and short-answer theory.

topics.name: Principal stresses, maximum shear stress and Mohr's circle
topics.evidence: Both papers include a 9-mark stress-transformation problem; May 2026 explicitly asks for Mohr's circle.

topics.name: Precision investment casting

topics.name: Chvorinov's rule and solidification time

topics.name: Sintering mechanisms and process parameters

topics.name: Oxy-acetylene welding, flames and applications

topics.name: Thermit welding

topics.name: Brazing, soldering and adhesive bonding
topics.evidence: 3-mark comparison.

topics.name: Heat-affected zone in welding

topics.name: Rolling mills and rolling defects

topics.name: Ring rolling and roll-bite condition

topics.name: Direct and indirect extrusion
topics.evidence: 4-mark comparison.

topics.name: Deep drawing and defects

topics.name: Open-die and closed-die forging
topics.evidence: Direct 3-mark comparison; Part A also tests grain flow and springback.

GNEST305.subject: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
GNEST305.evidence: Analysed two actual KTU S3 (R) November 2025 and S3 (S) May 2026 question papers (2024 Scheme). High priority means a topic appeared in both papers and/or carried substantial marks; medium means it appeared in one paper or mainly as a short-answer item. This is a two-paper trend, not a guarantee.

topics.name: Machine learning types, elements and applications
topics.evidence: Both papers test ML types/classification-regression or supervised/unsupervised learning; November 2025 also asks ML elements.

topics.name: Activation functions and artificial neural networks
topics.evidence: Activation-function question appears in both papers (4 marks in November 2025; 6 marks in May 2026).

topics.name: Perceptron, MLP and K-means clustering
topics.evidence: November 2025 has a 6-mark AND-gate perceptron problem; May 2026 has 5-mark K-means iteration and 4-mark MLP architecture.

topics.name: Universal Approximation Theorem
topics.evidence: Direct 3-mark question in November 2025 only.

topics.name: Singular Value Decomposition and matrix decomposition
topics.evidence: SVD is a 5-mark procedure question in November 2025 and a 4-mark numerical in May 2026.

topics.name: PCA and spectral decomposition
topics.evidence: PCA/spectral decomposition appears as a 5-mark question in both papers; May 2026 also asks PCA applications.

topics.name: Linear algebra, eigenvalues, eigenvectors and rank
topics.evidence: Linear algebra and matrix rank appear in November 2025; eigenvalues/eigenvectors and applications of linear algebra appear in May 2026.

topics.name: Least squares, covariance and Pearson correlation
topics.evidence: Least squares and covariance-versus-Pearson comparison appear in both papers; November 2025 also includes a 5-mark Pearson numerical.

topics.name: Probability distributions and Bayes' theorem
topics.evidence: November 2025 includes Bayes theorem and a 6-mark Bayes numerical; May 2026 asks probability distributions for 6 marks.

topics.name: Maximum likelihood estimation
topics.evidence: Direct 5-mark question in May 2026 only.

topics.name: Data processing and traditional versus big-data analysis
topics.evidence: Both papers ask data-processing steps (5 marks) and traditional versus big-data analysis (4 marks).

topics.name: Machine-learning applications in data science
topics.evidence: Both papers include a direct 3-mark question on applications of ML in data science.

topics.name: Five Vs of big data and data-science foundations
topics.evidence: Five Vs is a direct 3-mark question in November 2025; May 2026 asks the significance of statistics for data science.
